name: Open LMS
summary: A managed cloud learning management service built on Moodle open-source technology. Open LMS adds hosting, platform management, support, integrations and enterprise features for higher education and workplace learning.

value: managed support and plugin review available

value.notes: Not publicly listed; custom quote, vendor describes pricing by active user. Custom quote, priced per active user.

value.freeTierNote: No permanent free tier identified; hosted subscription is quote-based.
value.trialNote: Demo by enquiry; public trial not identified

security.notes: ISO 27001: vendor-listed; verify certificate validity, legal entity and scope

accessibility.finding: Open LMS designs to WCAG 2.2 AA and Section 508 and published a VPAT 2.5 conformance report for its EDU Platform (Snap theme) dated 8 July 2026. Its Moodle core is accredited separately.
accessibility.caveat: The report covers one theme and product line; check the edition you would buy.

security.finding: Open LMS says it has been independently audited and awarded ISO 27001, and describes itself as SOC 2 compliant.
security.caveat: Ask whether a SOC 2 Type II report exists, and its period.

dataResidency.finding: Open LMS hosts on AWS and says data stays in the customer's hosting region.
dataResidency.caveat: Confirm the Sydney region, backups and support access.

ai.finding: Open LMS advertises AI tools, but no model or training disclosure was found.

procurementChecks: Obtain current product-specific accessibility conformance report and confirm version/module scope.
Request current SOC 2 Type II / ISO certificates and verify legal entity, service boundary, audit period and exceptions.
Confirm production, backup, disaster-recovery, logs, telemetry, support and AI processing locations in contract/DPA.

researchTasks: Commercial relationship set to none; confirm before publication (affiliate programs in docs/affiliates.md).
* trial: no public trial terms, so left out (not set to false): Demo by enquiry; public trial not identified.
* accessibility standard: not a conformance claim, so stored as evidence and the standard left out.
* data residency: no committed region; confirm the tenant region in the contract.
* AI models: no named model or provider, so models is empty; the description is kept as a note.

value.evidence: Not publicly confirmed in reviewed sources Request current Open LMS ACR/VPAT for the hosted product version and any Moodle-derived customisations.

value.notes: Cloud-hosted; region options and customer-specific residency should be confirmed in the service agreement. Confirm contracted region, subprocessors, support access and retention in Open LMS DPA.
AI functionality may be available through Moodle-derived capabilities, plugins or integrations; model/provider depends on the deployed version and configuration and was not confirmed.
